Settings

Appearance

Choose your preferred color theme. System mode automatically matches your operating system's theme.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Use keyboard shortcuts for quick navigation and actions. Press ? to see all available shortcuts.

Recent Connections

Display your most recent connections for quick reconnect. Set to 0 to hide the recent connections bar.

Terminal

Choose which terminal application to use when connecting to SSH profiles. When enabled, profiles open as tabs in existing terminal windows (macOS Terminal, Windows Terminal).

Profile Management

Export profiles to share, import from JSON file, or delete all profiles permanently.
Security Warning: When "Include Passwords in Export" is enabled, exported files contain passwords in plaintext. Store exported files securely and consider using filesystem encryption.

Settings Management

Backup, restore, or reset settings to defaults. When "Include Profiles" is enabled, all profiles will be included in the backup.
Security Warning: When "Include Profiles" is enabled and "Include Passwords in Export" is checked in Profile Management, backups will contain passwords in plaintext. Store backup files securely and consider using filesystem encryption.

Updates

Automatically check for new versions when the app starts, or check manually.
